why_next: This experiment was MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to two infrastructure bugs that prevented valid distributed data collection. The parent's two prerequisite bugs (SameFileError, C1 304-exclusion) are both fixed, but a new DistributedManager RSA key sharing bug replaces them: each Flask node generates independent RSA key pairs, so round-robin routing (get_token on node N, request on node N+1) produces 100% 401 responses on all valid-token samples, making behavioral signal degenerate (constant 7.0, std 0) and all C1-C7 conditions uncomputable. A secondary JSON serialization bug (numpy.bool_ in json.dump) masks raw evidence in result.json but the auditor recovered metrics from raw_evidence/ artifacts. Three fix pathways exist for RSA: (a) generate RSA keys once and share via file/env, (b) switch to HS256 symmetric JWT with shared TESTBED_SECRET, or (c) implement sticky affinity where get_token and subsequent request use the same node. The frozen question (distributed CONFIRMED at n>=800) remains unanswered.
